components.name: Button
components.note: Size axis order is Medium, Small, Large and the default variant is Size=Medium, matching the code default. Corrected 2026-08-03 — see flags.sizeDefaultResolvedByCanvasPositionNotLayerOrder. The default is held by CANVAS POSITION (Medium/Default is the top-left variant), not by axis order or child order; do not 'tidy' the grid by moving the Small block back to the left.

components.name: Button group / Segment
components.layer: themed — ButtonGroupOverrides is post-0.7.0 and executes

Held by canvas position — Medium/Default is the top-left variant. The Size axis option order still reads Small, Medium, Large; that is cosmetic and does not drive the default. See flags.buttonGroupSizeDefaultInverted.

components.note: info.dark / success.dark, NOT grey[900] — see flags.snackbarIsTealNotGrey. Elevation / 6. Anchoring is runtime and not modelled.

components.name: Autocomplete / Option
components.converted: Grouped was a No/Yes variant axis; converted to BOOLEAN, halving the set from 10 to 5. Backed by an 8px 'Group indent' spacer because a Figma boolean toggles visibility but cannot change padding. Verified: label x moves 16 -> 24, matching MUI's AutocompleteGroupUl paddingLeft 24 against the base 16.

components.name: Tabs / Tab
components.layer: substrate geometry and colour, one Tebra hover
components.note: TabOverrides.tsx supplies only '&:hover, &:active' = action.hover #CBDDE0. Everything else is MUI. The indicator is a 2px primary.main bar that Tabs clones INTO the selected Tab, so it lives on the Selected=Yes variants. No Disabled: the story never sets it. See flags.overridesThatRestateMuiDefaults for TabsOverrides.

components.name: Tabs
components.layer: substrate
components.note: Container composite: three Tab instances, third selected, matching the story's value={2}. minHeight 48, overflow hidden, no padding or gap.

components.name: Toggle button
components.layer: mixed — Tebra supplies root colour, border and both selected states; hover and unselected-disabled are substrate
components.note: Boxes 36 / 48 / 67 as intended (38.86 / 51.43 / 72 as rendered — icons carry the pxToRem inflation). Size ordered Medium-first because medium is the code default. See flags.toggleButtonDisabledRuleIsDeadJss, toggleButtonSelectedBackgroundLostOnHover, toggleButtonStorySizeIsNotAValidSize.

components.name: Stepper / Step
components.layer: substrate + one Tebra completed colour

components.name: Stepper
components.layer: substrate
components.note: Horizontal linear composite at activeStep 0: Active / Default+Optional / Default with two connectors. Connectors are grey[400] at every state — see flags.stepperConnectorIgnoresItsOwnState. StepButton adds no visual surface, so the non-linear story needs no separate component.

components.name: Mobile stepper
components.layer: themed root and dot over MUI substrate
components.note: Tebra changes root background to background.paper (MUI's base is background.default) and dot to grey[400] (base is action.disabled); dotActive restates primary.main and changes nothing. Buttons are an honest inline construction, NOT Button instances — the story passes the caret as a plain child, so there is no startIcon margin. Width 400 is the story's Box maxWidth.

components.name: Avatar
components.layer: SUBSTRATE — AvatarOverrides.ts is an empty shell
components.note: No Size axis: Avatar has no size prop and the story disables it in argTypes. No Variant axis: the story never sets rounded or square. The img content path is documented, not built. See flags.avatarOverrideIsAnEmptyShell, avatarImageVariantNotBuildable.

components.name: Badge
components.layer: substrate — BadgeOverrides.ts is defaultProps { color: 'secondary' } only
components.note: Variant axis comes from the story's own argTypes options. The badge overhangs its child by design (translate(50%,-50%) about the top-right corner); it is centred with a 48-wide anchor frame and the component has clipsContent false. Any wrapper that nests it must too.

components.name: Circular progress
components.layer: substrate — no override file
components.note: Built as an arc ellipse: outer radius 20, innerRadius ratio 18.4/22 = 0.8364, sweep 226.91 degrees from 3 o'clock. See flags.circularProgressArcIsTheStaticDeclaredState.

components.name: Read more
components.layer: Tebra composition over a MUI text Button
components.note: Width 700 from the Box every story wraps its example in. Lines/Collapsed is 72px (three 24px body1 lines, fitted by truncation because Figma has no -webkit-line-clamp); Characters/Collapsed is substring(0,150) + "..." exactly as the component composes it, 48px; Expanded is the full story sample, 240px. Toggle is 24px tall — StyledButton sets padding 0, so the height is the button line-height alone. NO text component properties: a set-level TEXT property forces one default across every variant and wiped the per-variant copy the axes exist to show. See flags.readMoreButtonColourInvertsOnHover, readMoreStoryInlinePropTypo.

components.name: Feedback message
components.layer: Tebra composition — Box + Stack + Typography, optionally wrapped in a MUI Paper
components.note: Container is the withContainer prop, default true, so Yes is first. All 12 are 815 wide = 735 content + 40 padding either side. The six disagree on marginTop (0/16/24), spacing (8/16), eyebrow (3 of 6), title maxWidth (45ch on 3 of 6) and action button (2 of 6) — all built as they ship. Action buttons are instances of the Button set at contained/primary/medium, because ButtonOverrides.defaultProps sets variant "contained". NO text component properties, for the same reason as Read more. See flags.feedbackMessageSiblingsDisagree, forbiddenUsesRawAnchor, notFoundMessageMissingJsxSpace, chUnitNotExpressibleInFigma.

icons._addendum: 2026-08-03 nav glyphs — 9 added, taking the Icons & illustrations page to 47 masters (40 icons + 7 illustrations). SearchOutlined was added in the review pass for the search field adornment.
icons.convention: Named after the source filename with the trailing "Icon" stripped, matching DownCaretIcon.tsx -> Icon / DownCaret. MUI-internal glyphs keep the (MUI) suffix.
icons.binding: All bound to color/common/white, because the nav glyph rule is navText — these masters are white by default, unlike the canonical icons.
icons.caveat: These are the FIRST icon masters bound white rather than to a canonical text colour. They are correct for the nav and wrong anywhere else; do not reuse them on canonical surfaces.

textStyles.source: packages/design-system/src/typography/typography.ts — names match the code keys exactly
textStyles.binding: Each style binds fontSize, lineHeight and fontFamily to Tebra/Typography variables.
textStyles.factoring: One variable per distinct VALUE, one style per ROLE. typography.ts gives several roles identical literals (h4 == body1 at 16/24; h5 == body2 at 14/20; subtitle2 == caption at 12/16), so those styles bind the shared value token rather than duplicating it. Each style's description records which token it binds and why.
textStyles.weightMapping: typography.ts uses only 400 and 700. Akkurat LL ships Regular and Bold exactly, so NO substitution occurs anywhere in this ramp — see flags.akkuratMediumSubstitutionScope.

blockers.detail: The second COMPONENT_SET named 'Button' (38:6) and the flattened 'ButtonGroup / Primary / Medium / Default — Akkurat' (57:17) were removed with their page, 'Storybook rebuild — working'. Zero external instances existed, so nothing broke. Stray-component scan now returns empty.

blockers.severity: CLOSED — accepted by Daniel 2026-08-02; stop reporting it
blockers.detail: Button's Size axis resolves to Small. componentPropertyDefinitions.Size.defaultValue = 'Small' and defaultVariant = 'Variant=Contained, Color=Primary, Size=Small, State=Default', even though children[0] is the Medium variant. The manual UI reorder has not taken effect. The API cannot set a variant default, so this must be fixed in the UI and re-verified before publish.

carriedForward.detail: ButtonGroup exists in code (overrides/ButtonGroupOverrides.ts + stories/ButtonGroup) but has NO canonical Figma component. Its only representation was the flattened single-state component deleted with the superseded page. Backlog item, not a publish blocker.

The one real Akkurat LL weight substitution is the Autocomplete group label: MUI ListSubheader uses fontWeightMedium (500) and Akkurat has no Medium face, so it is built at Regular. It sits OUTSIDE the typography.ts ramp, so no text style carries that note. If a style for it is wanted, it needs a name outside the code-key convention.

carriedForward: 2026-08-03 nav addendum: four Nav / * components added under the partner theme. They are deliberately NOT instances of the canonical primitives and must never be reconciled with them — the divergence is the point. Freeze applies to their names and axes as listed; the six-theme cobranding expansion is out of freeze because it is not built.

confusionRisks.detail: 'Icon / Close (MUI)' renamed to 'Icon / Clear (MUI)' — named by role since it has no Tebra source file to trace. 'Icon / CloseOutlined' keeps its name. The two no longer collide in insert-search.

Kept as 'Icon / LinearEllipsis' per the source-filename convention. Description now carries search aliases: kebab, overflow menu, more, vertical ellipsis, MoreVert. Figma insert-search weights names over descriptions, so this may still not surface on 'kebab'. Flagged for a discoverability re-check after real use — renaming is only cheap before publish.
Field's TEXT property stays 'Value text' alongside the 'Value' axis. Mirrors MUI's own semantics; renaming away from code costs traceability for cosmetic gain.
'Selected focused' and 'Focus visible' stay. They mirror MUI's actual state semantics (.Mui-focused, .Mui-focusVisible).
Collections are named 'Tebra/Color' etc. Figma does not nest collections, so the slash renders literally in the variable picker.

palette._note: Only six distinct colours across all seven SVGs, plus white. Four map exactly to palette entries; two do not.
palette.#004952: illustrationTeal — 405 uses. NOT palette primary.main #004852. See flags.illustrationTealIsOffPalette.
palette.#F8F3EB: illustrationCream — 1 use, no palette entry. See flags.illustrationCreamHasNoPaletteEntry.
palette.white: common.white — 11 uses, declared as the named colour "white" rather than a hex, which a hex-only grep misses

illustrations.recipe: figma.createNodeFromSvg at the viewBox, then walk every descendant binding each SOLID fill and stroke to a variable, set SCALE/SCALE constraints on every shape, and clear the root frame fill — createNodeFromSvg gives the wrapper frame an opaque white background that the source (<svg fill="none">) does not have. That fill was the one unbound paint the first audit caught, on all seven masters.
